title: Repayment dated on the business date succeeds (C44)

source.test: check that the repayment is successful if the repayment date is equal to the business date

scenario: With business date 1 July 2022, make a repayment dated 1 July 2022; a 200 AUTOPAY transaction must be created.
grade: Assert a repayment dated exactly on the business date is accepted and creates the 20000-minor AUTOPAY transaction.
